text:
This 2 distills in a single batch,
and between us both we drain it.
No one had heard me. Burning groove,
civil abracadabra.

The morning does not feel like the first,
like the last stone ovulating
by force of secrecy. The morning barefoot.
The mud halfway
between gray substances, more and less.
Faces know nothing of the face, nor of the
march toward encounters.
And without a toward the exergue nods.
The point of longing strays.

June, you are ours. June, and on your shoulders
I stand and roar with laughter, drying
my meter and my pockets
on your 21 seasonal nails.

Good! Good!

translation.title: Trilce: Poem XVII — This 2 Distills in a Single Batch
translation.editorial_note: The numeral remains an intimate substance consumed by two; ovulandas becomes ovulating without repairing its syntax, and sin hacia is kept as the absence of a directional toward.
